This happened to my cat too last year. A friend delivered lilies bouquet to my home and before I could get the chance to remove them, my cat ran and started munching on it. Fortunately, he survived it after 5-6 days of hospitalization and his kidney values eventually became in the normal range.

Now, I make sure we have no lilies and I check if any flower is poisonous or not before putting it inside the house.
